draft.text: You came in because you hurt your right shoulder while playing tackle football a few days ago.
You said the injury happened when you landed on your shoulder after being tackled.
You have pain when lifting your arm up to your ear and trouble lifting heavy things.
You also have tenderness on the back of your shoulder near your collarbone.
You may have an injury to your shoulder, but we don't know the exact type or severity yet.
We don't know if there is a break, dislocation, or damage to the soft tissues in your shoulder.
You are willing to have a CT scan to look more closely at your shoulder injury.
Your doctor will order imaging to check for possible fractures, dislocations, or soft tissue injuries.
You should avoid lifting heavy objects and let your doctor know if your symptoms change or if you have more trouble moving your arm.
